treatments.name: Acne & acne scars
treatments.description: Medicines, skin-care advice and in-clinic procedures to bring breakouts under control and soften the marks they leave.
treatments.forWhom: Pimples, blackheads, painful cysts, dark or pitted marks.

treatments.name: Pigmentation & melasma
treatments.description: Finding the cause of the dark patches first, then creams, sun-protection advice and peels where they suit your skin.
treatments.forWhom: Melasma, tanning, dark circles, uneven skin tone.

treatments.name: Eczema & psoriasis
treatments.description: Long-term care to calm flare-ups, ease the itch and keep skin comfortable between visits.
treatments.forWhom: Dry, scaly, itchy or inflamed patches that keep returning.

treatments.name: Fungal infections
treatments.description: A clear diagnosis and a full course of treatment, so the infection clears instead of returning after creams.
treatments.forWhom: Ringworm, jock itch, nail fungus, recurring itchy rashes.

treatments.name: Vitiligo & white patches
treatments.description: Examination of the white patches and a treatment plan to slow their spread and help colour return.
treatments.forWhom: White or light patches on the skin or lips.

treatments.name: Skin allergies & hives
treatments.description: Working out what sets off the reaction, then treating the rash, swelling and itch.
treatments.forWhom: Hives (urticaria), contact allergy, rashes after medicines.

treatments.name: Hair fall & thinning
treatments.description: A scalp examination and, where needed, blood tests to find the reason, then treatment matched to it.
treatments.forWhom: Heavy shedding, a widening parting, a receding hairline.

treatments.name: Dandruff & scalp care
treatments.description: Treatment for flaking, itching and infections of the scalp.
treatments.forWhom: Dandruff, seborrhoeic dermatitis, an itchy or sore scalp.

treatments.name: Patchy hair loss
treatments.description: Treatment for alopecia areata, including in-clinic injections into the patches where suitable.
treatments.forWhom: Round bald patches on the scalp or beard.

treatments.name: PRP for hair
treatments.description: Platelet-rich plasma, prepared from a small sample of your own blood, is injected into the scalp to support hair growth. Done as a course of sessions.
treatments.forWhom: Early thinning, as part of a wider hair-fall plan.

treatments.name: Laser hair reduction
treatments.description: Laser sessions that reduce unwanted hair growth over a course of treatments, spaced a few weeks apart.
treatments.forWhom: Face, underarms, arms and legs; excess hair from hormonal causes.

treatments.name: Chemical peels
treatments.description: A controlled peel applied in the clinic that clears the outer layer of skin to improve tone and texture.
treatments.forWhom: Acne marks, tanning, dull or uneven skin.

treatments.name: Acne-scar procedures
treatments.description: Microneedling and similar procedures to smooth depressed scars, done over several sessions.
treatments.forWhom: Pitted, rolling or boxcar acne scars.

treatments.name: Mole, wart & skin-tag removal
treatments.description: Minor procedures under local anaesthesia, usually finished in a single visit.
treatments.forWhom: Warts, skin tags, moles, corns, milia.
